svg.style: background-color: #060814; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.text: End-to-end framework integrating 6-DOF Keplerian-J₂ orbital dynamics, dynamic laser crosslinks, multi-modal GAT-LSTM-RF risk inference, distributed auction matching, and constrained 6-DOF MPC.

g.text: • ṙ = v, v̇ = a_grav + a_J2 + (F_thrust / m)
• Euler Angles: Θ = [ϕ, θ, ψ]ᵀ (Roll, Pitch, Yaw)
• Rigid Body: J ω̇ + ω × (J ω) = τ_control
➤ True State X(t) = [r, v, Θ, ω, Batt, Health]ᵀ
• LOS_ij = 1 if clear ray, 0 if blocked
• Node Features h_i ∈ ℝ⁷: [SoC, H, R, d_tgt, Alt, Q, Deg]
• Predicts battery SoC drift & thermal fatigue
• Random Forest (80 trees): Anomaly score r̂
• Multi-Modal Fusion: z_fused = LayerNorm(W_f [z^GAT ‖ z^LSTM ‖ z^RF])
• C(i, j) = α·Dist_ij + β·Risk_i - γ·Batt_i + δ·Delay_ij
b_ij = v_ij - p_j + ε, p_j ← p_j + max(b_ij)
➤ Target Assignment Vector: Sat i* → Target j*
• Discrete Dynamics: x_{k+1} = A_k x_k + B_k u_k
• Solved via OSQP Convex Solver (4.38 ms)
• Optical Sensor Lock & Earth Surface Imaging
High-Frequency Real-Time Telemetry & State Feedback (Δt = 0.1 s, 10 Hz):

True state vector [r(t), v(t), Θ(t), ω(t), SoC(t)] + microsecond Multi-Agent flight event stream continuously recirculate into Stage 1 (Dynamics) & Stage 2 (ISL Topology) for receding horizon closed-loop execution.
